name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: Illusion-Breaking Strength now shows next to Ability Score on each meter row — turn it on in Appearance → Other.
Search your combat history, and choose how many past runs to keep (Auto-archive settings).
fixed: Raids now detect boss kills correctly, so a cleared raid no longer shows as partial.
Re-entering the same dungeon no longer merges two separate runs into one history row.
